evals.prompt: The $50 million Award Amount is a $50 million payment made this year.
evals.expected_output: The agent distinguishes award amount from transaction obligations, outlays, and payments and uses the appropriate follow-up data.

evals.prompt: This recipient name proves the award went to the company I mean.
evals.expected_output: The agent resolves the recipient with UEI, generated award ID, agency, location, and other identifiers rather than name alone.

evals.prompt: Search FY2025, meaning January through December 2025.
evals.expected_output: The agent corrects the federal fiscal-year window to 2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30.

evals.prompt: List every subcontract and payment under these awards.
evals.expected_output: The agent states that this skill returns prime award rows and that subaward/transaction operations are not released.

evals.prompt: No grant result means the recipient got no federal money.
evals.expected_output: The agent limits the conclusion to the selected type, window, filters, and prime-award endpoint and checks other award groups/corrections.
